body.statement: Bojinov, Simchi-Levi, and Zhao study a known exact finite carryover order, optimize Horvitz--Thompson risk over a precommitted class of regular switchback designs, and use a treatment-effect estimand with an initial boundary truncation.  Their result is not an all-sequential-policy minimax theorem over arbitrary estimators.

source.locator: Sections 2--4, including the definitions of the finite carryover model, the DATE, regular switchback designs, and the Horvitz--Thompson risk criterion

attestation.note: The scope is recorded from the cited article location and the stable arXiv carrier; it is used only to delimit the comparison and not as a premise for the new risk inequalities.
